license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing as a registered nurse, represent the person as being a registered nurse, or use the title "registered nurse," the initials "R.N.," or any other title implying that the person is a registered nurse, for a fee, salary, or other consideration, or as a volunteer, without holding a current, valid license as a registered nurse under this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: The board of nursing shall: Administer and enforce the provisions of this chapter

name.quote: The board of nursing shall: Administer and enforce the provisions of this chapter, including the taking of disciplinary action

type.quote: The board of nursing shall administer and enforce the provisions of this chapter

degree_required.value: Completion of an approved nursing education program (diploma, associate, baccalaureate, master's, or doctoral for RN; practical nurse program for LPN)
degree_required.quote: Prelicensure nursing education programs include, but are not limited to, diploma, associate degree, baccalaureate degree, master's degree, and doctor of nursing programs leading to initial licensure to practice nursing as a registered nurse and practical nurse programs leading to initial licensure to practice nursing as a licensed practical nurse.

accrediting_body.value: Board of Nursing or board of another jurisdiction that is a member of the national council of state boards of nursing
accrediting_body.quote: a nursing education program approved by the board under division (A) of section 4723.06 of the Revised Code; a nursing education program approved by a board of another jurisdiction that is a member of the national council of state boards of nursing.

exams.name: NCLEX (National Council Licensure Examination)
exams.notes: Board accepts the licensure examination of the national council of state boards of nursing or any other national standardized nursing examination
exams.quote: the board of nursing shall accept all or any part of the licensure examination of the national council of state boards of nursing or any other national standardized nursing examination that the board considers to be an appropriate measure of whether a person is competent to commence practicing nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse.

interval_years.quote: An active license to practice nursing as a registered nurse is subject to renewal in odd-numbered years.

required.quote: to be eligible for renewal of an active license to practice nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse, each individual who holds an active license shall, in each two-year period specified by the board, complete continuing nursing education

hours_per_period.quote: For renewal of a license that was issued for a two-year renewal period, twenty-four hours of continuing nursing education

period_years.quote: in each two-year period specified by the board, complete continuing nursing education

value: At least one hour directly related to the statutes and rules pertaining to the practice of nursing in this state
For APRN (CNS, CNM, CNP): at least twelve hours in advanced pharmacology from an accredited institution recognized by the board
topical_requirements.quote: of the hours of continuing nursing education completed in any renewal period, at least one hour of the education must be directly related to the statutes and rules pertaining to the practice of nursing in this state

available.quote: An application for licensure by endorsement to practice nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse shall be submitted to the board in the form prescribed by rules of the board.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current, valid, unrestricted license from another jurisdiction, pass an equivalent examination, complete 2 contact hours of CE related to Ohio nursing statutes/rules, pass criminal records check, and not have committed any act that is grounds for disciplinary action.
requirements.quote: Evidence that the applicant holds a current, valid, and unrestricted license or equivalent authorization from another jurisdiction other than another state granted after passing an examination approved by the board of that jurisdiction that is equivalent to the examination requirements under this chapter

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing as a registered nurse, represent the person as being a registered nurse, or use the title "registered nurse," the initials "R.N.," or any other title implying that the person is a registered nurse, for a fee, salary, or other consideration, or as a volunteer, without holding a current, valid license as a registered nurse under this chapter.

credential_type.quote: The board of nursing shall grant a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse if the following conditions are met

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing as a registered nurse, represent the person as being a registered nurse, or use the title "registered nurse," the initials "R.N.," or any other title implying that the person is a registered nurse, for a fee, salary, or other consideration, or as a volunteer, without holding a current, valid license as a registered nurse under this chapter.

title_protection.quote: No person shall use the titles or initials "graduate nurse," "G.N.," "professional nurse," "P.N.," "graduate practical nurse," "G.P.N.," "practical nurse," "P.N.," "trained nurse," "T.N.," or any other statement, title, or initials that would imply or represent to the public that the person is authorized to practice nursing in this state

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of nursing as a registered nurse, represent the person as being a registered nurse, or use the title "registered nurse," the initials "R.N.," or any other title implying that the person is a registered nurse, for a fee, salary, or other consideration, or as a volunteer, without holding a current, valid license as a registered nurse under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a nursing license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for or securing a nursing license or dialysis technician certificate issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial, revocation, suspension, or restriction of authority to engage in nursing in Ohio or another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Denial, revocation, suspension, or restriction of authority to engage in a licensed profession or practice a health care occupation, including nursing or practice as a dialysis technician, for any reason other than a failure to renew, in Ohio or another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of nursing with a lapsed or suspended license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of nursing or engaging in practice as a dialysis technician, having failed to renew a nursing license or dialysis technician certificate issued under this chapter, or while a nursing license or dialysis technician certificate is under suspension

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of, a plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, a judicial finding of guilt resulting from a plea of no contest to, or a judicial finding of eligibility for a pretrial diversion or similar program or for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony or crime involving gross immorality or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of, a plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, a judicial finding of guilt resulting from a plea of no contest to, or a judicial finding of eligibility for a pretrial diversion or similar program or for intervention in lieu of conviction for, any felony or of any crime involving gross immorality or moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, giving away, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes, or violating drug laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Selling, giving away, or administering drugs or therapeutic devices for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes; or conviction of, a plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, a judicial finding of guilt resulting from a plea of no contest to, or a judicial finding of eligibility for a pretrial diversion or similar program or for intervention in lieu of conviction for, violating any municipal, state, county, or federal drug law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Self-administering any dangerous drug not in accordance with a valid prescription, or any schedule I controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Self-administering or otherwise taking into the body any dangerous drug, as defined in section 4729.01 of the Revised Code, in any way that is not in accordance with a legal, valid prescription issued for that individual, or self-administering or otherwise taking into the body any drug that is a schedule I controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use of controlled substances, habit-forming drugs, or alcohol to an extent that impairs ability to provide safe nursing care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use of controlled substances, other habit-forming drugs, or alcohol or other chemical substances to an extent that impairs the individual's ability to provide safe nursing care or safe dialysis care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice according to acceptable standards because of use of drugs, alcohol, or other chemical substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of the ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of safe nursing care or safe dialysis care because of the use of drugs, alcohol, or other chemical substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice according to acceptable standards because of a physical or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of the ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of safe nursing care or safe dialysis care because of a physical or mental disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assaulting or causing harm to a patient or depriving a patient of the means to summon assistance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assaulting or causing harm to a patient or depriving a patient of the means to summon assistance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misappropriation or attempted misappropriation of money or anything of value in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misappropriation or attempted misappropriation of money or anything of value in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to practice in accordance with acceptable and prevailing standards of safe nursing care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to practice in accordance with acceptable and prevailing standards of safe nursing care or safe dialysis care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in activities that exceed the authorized scope of practice for the nurse's license type
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a registered nurse, engaging in activities that exceed the practice of nursing as a registered nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding and abetting a person in practicing nursing without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding and abetting a person in that person's practice of nursing without a license or practice as a dialysis technician without a certificate issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of this chapter or any rules adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of this chapter or any rules adopted under it

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to use universal and standard precautions established by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to use universal and standard precautions established by rules adopted under section 4723.07 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual contact or sexually demeaning verbal behavior with a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Regardless of whether the contact or verbal behavior is consensual, engaging with a patient other than the spouse of the registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or dialysis technician in any of the following: Sexual contact, as defined in section 2907.01 of the Revised Code; Verbal behavior that is sexually demeaning to the patient or may be reasonably interpreted by the patient as sexually demeaning.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish and maintain professional boundaries with a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish and maintain professional boundaries with a patient, as specified in rules adopted under section 4723.07 of the Revised Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with an investigation conducted by the board, including failure to comply with a subpoena or answer questions truthfully
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with an investigation conducted by the board under this chapter, including failure to comply with a subpoena or order issued by the board or failure to answer truthfully a question presented by the board in an investigative interview

definition_quote.value: Practice of nursing as a registered nurse means providing to individuals and groups nursing care requiring specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill derived from the principles of biological, physical, behavioral, social, and nursing sciences.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing as a registered nurse" means providing to individuals and groups nursing care requiring specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill derived from the principles of biological, physical, behavioral, social, and nursing sciences.

value: Identifying patterns of human responses to actual or potential health problems amenable to a nursing regimen
Executing a nursing regimen through the selection, performance, management, and evaluation of nursing actions
Assessing health status for the purpose of providing nursing care
Providing health counseling and health teaching
Administering medications, treatments, and executing regimens authorized by an individual authorized to practice in this state
Teaching, administering, supervising, delegating, and evaluating nursing practice
methods_authorized.quote: Such nursing care includes: Identifying patterns of human responses to actual or potential health problems amenable to a nursing regimen; Executing a nursing regimen through the selection, performance, management, and evaluation of nursing actions; Assessing health status for the purpose of providing nursing care; Providing health counseling and health teaching; Administering medications, treatments, and executing regimens authorized by an individual who is authorized to practice in this state

drug_authority.value: RNs may administer medications and treatments authorized by a licensed practitioner. APRNs designated as CNS, CNM, or CNP may prescribe and personally furnish drugs and therapeutic devices in collaboration with a physician or podiatrist, subject to the exclusionary formulary and other restrictions.
drug_authority.quote: A clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner shall not prescribe or furnish any drug or therapeutic device that is listed on the exclusionary formulary established in rules adopted under section 4723.50 of the Revised Code.

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Nurse Practitioner (CNP)
license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter that authorizes the practice of nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse and is designated as any of the following: A certified registered nurse anesthetist; A clinical nurse specialist; A certified nurse-midwife; A certified nurse practitioner.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means an individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter that authorizes the practice of nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse and is designated as any of the following: A certified registered nurse anesthetist; A clinical nurse specialist; A certified nurse-midwife; A certified nurse practitioner.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "The practice of nursing as a licensed practical nurse" means providing to individuals and groups nursing care requiring the application of basic knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, social, and nursing sciences at the direction of a registered nurse or any of the following who is authorized to practice in this state: a physician, physician assistant, dentist, podiatrist, optometrist, or chiropractor.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is designated as a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner may practice only in accordance with a standard care arrangement entered into with each physician or podiatrist with whom the nurse collaborates.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is designated as a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner may practice only in accordance with a standard care arrangement entered into with each physician or podiatrist with whom the nurse collaborates.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: This section establishes standards and conditions regarding the authority of an advanced practice registered nurse who is designated as a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner to prescribe and personally furnish drugs and therapeutic devices under a license issued under section 4723.42 of the Revised Code.

value: Schedule II (with restrictions - terminal condition, physician initially prescribed, 72-hour supply limit, or from specified facility types)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: Except as provided in division (C)(2) or (3) of this section, a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner may prescribe to a patient a schedule II controlled substance only if all of the following are the case: The patient has a terminal condition

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Must comply with section 3719.061 before issuing a prescription for an opioid analgesic for a minor; must check the drug database before prescribing opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner shall comply with section 3719.061 of the Revised Code if the nurse prescribes for a minor, as defined in that section, an opioid analgesic, as defined in section 3719.01 of the Revised Code.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: an advanced practice registered nurse who is designated as a clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner shall comply with all of the following as conditions of prescribing a drug that is either an opioid analgesic or a benzodiazepine as part of a patient's course of treatment for a particular condition: Before initially prescribing the drug, the advanced practice registered nurse or the advanced practice registered nurse's delegate shall request from the drug database a report of information related to the patient

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The director of health shall establish a state nurse aide registry listing all individuals who have done any of the following

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Medication aide" means an individual who holds a current, valid certificate issued under this chapter that authorizes the individual to administer medication in accordance with section 4723.67 of the Revised Code

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse-midwife, or certified nurse practitioner who holds a license to practice nursing issued under section 4723.42 of the Revised Code may delegate to a person not otherwise authorized to administer drugs the authority to administer to a specified patient a drug

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: A person or governmental entity that employs, or contracts directly or through another person or governmental entity for the provision of services by, registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, nurses holding multistate licenses to practice registered or licensed practical nursing issued pursuant to section 4723.11 of the Revised Code, dialysis technicians, medication aides, or certified community health workers and that knows or has reason to believe that a current or former employee or person providing services under a contract who holds a license or certificate issued under this chapter engaged in conduct that would be grounds for disciplinary action by the board of nursing under this chapter or rules adopted under it shall report to the board of nursing the name of such current or former employee or person providing services under a contract.

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The "Nurse Licensure Compact" is hereby ratified, enacted into law, and entered into by the state of Ohio as a party to the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical nursing issued pursuant to section 4723.11 of the Revised Code is an option for licensure in addition to a traditional license to practice as a registered nurse or as a licensed practical nurse issued pursuant to section 4723.09 of the Revised Code.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board of nursing shall establish the safe haven program to monitor applicants and practitioners who are or may be impaired, but against whom the board has abstained from taking disciplinary action.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: A registered nurse who is not described in division (A) of this section may determine and pronounce an individual's death, but only if the individual's respiratory and circulatory functions are not being artificially sustained and, at the time the determination and pronouncement of death is made, the registered nurse is providing or supervising the individual's care through a hospice care program licensed under Chapter 3712. of the Revised Code or any other entity that provides palliative care.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An advanced practice registered nurse may provide telehealth services in accordance with section 4743.09 of the Revised Code.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may provide telehealth services in accordance with section 4743.09 of the Revised Code.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: "Supervision," as it pertains to a certified registered nurse anesthetist, means that the certified registered nurse anesthetist is under the direction of a podiatrist acting within the podiatrist's scope of practice in accordance with section 4731.51 of the Revised Code, a dentist acting within the dentist's scope of practice in accordance with Chapter 4715. of the Revised Code, or a physician, and, when administering anesthesia, the certified registered nurse anesthetist is in the immediate presence of the podiatrist, dentist, or physician.

cnm_out_of_hospital_birth_authorized.quote: A nurse authorized to practice as a certified nurse-midwife, in collaboration with one or more physicians, may provide the management of preventive services and those primary care services necessary to provide health care to women antepartally, intrapartally, postpartally, and gynecologically

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: The board shall adopt rules establishing an exclusionary formulary. The exclusionary formulary shall permit, in a manner consistent with section 4723.481 of the Revised Code, the prescribing of controlled substances
